scope: Portable typography with explicit font availability and export policy
limits: Mac target requires macOS15.4+ for native Canvas letterSpacing (Safari18.4); Xcode16+ remains supported.
Maple Sans embeds unmodified Inter4.1 with OFL1.1 notices; other scripts use installed glyph fallback.
Local fonts remain installation dependencies on export consumers; arbitrary font-file import stays in issue19.

SwiftUI maps system, sans-serif, serif and monospace plus tracking/alignment; custom font registration and exact nondefault line-height explicitly reject. Native default line-height follows SwiftUI font metrics; no pixel-equivalence claim.
Web geometry fixtures compare node bounds, not glyph raster pixel identity.
Advanced wrapping, bidirectional direction controls and typography token/mode identity remain in parent issues9/10/11.
SVG/PNG retains typography fields and embeds the bundled font; its historical fixed-size serializer does not yet implement browser-equivalent wrapping.
The font is a binary app asset; web exports encode it with the license. Native custom-scheme fetch status0 is accepted after validating the WOFF2 header.
